PhD candidate in Mathematics at [IBILCE-UNESP](https://www.ibilce.unesp.br/) (São José do Rio Preto, Brazil), in a joint degree with the [Universidad de Sevilla](https://www.us.es/) (Spain), under the supervision of

- Profa. Dra. [Suzete Maria Silva Afonso](http://lattes.cnpq.br/3759335100023544) and 
- Prof. Dr. [Tomás Caraballo Garrido](https://personal.us.es/caraball/).

## Research interests

 Mainly interested in mathematical analysis, and my research concerns the study of qualitative properties of Generalized ODEs, Generalized Stochastic Equations, Interactive Fuzzy Differential Equations and their relation with dynamical systems.
